evidence.summary: 5-angle + eye-level captures match amphitheatre reference: sunken sand bowl ringed by sandstone tiers/terracotta wall, gate corridor, broken obelisk, lit braziers under warm dust haze at character scale.

reasons: All brief features present: quarry-hill bowl, tiers, ring wall, grand gate, monument, dressing
Palette coherent sandstone+terracotta; golden-hour haze confirmed (ClockTime 16.4, Atmosphere 0.38/1.2)
Scale correct vs 5-stud character; footprint ~49.3k studs2 within ~6% of 52k config
Minor: exposed Kit template parts on outer slope + clean grout - cosmetic, non-blocking

config.theme: Ember Quarry Arena - ruined sandstone/terracotta amphitheatre sunk in desert quarry hills, golden-hour dust haze

steps: Loaded environment rubric + amphitheatre/quarry references (elliptical sand floor, ring wall, stepped tiers, hills enclosing)

Staged a 2-piece kit (KitWall brick-painted, KitTier tile-painted via paint_texture) and cloned it into a 24-segment ring wall with cap trim + 72 stepped seating tiers, ruin variation (height drops, broken chunks, per-clone tint)
Built focal GrandGate (twin pylons, lintel, terracotta banners) on the north gap with a walled entry corridor + SpawnLocation at its mouth; broken-obelisk Monument opposite with fallen tip
Dressed: 4 brazier fire+PointLight mood accents, amphora clusters (Cube mesh, scaled/rotated/tipped), rubble at wall bases, sparring posts; author_mesh rock outcrops scaled 0.7-1.9x on the apron
Sculpted Terrain berm/hill ring (Sandstone + Ground + LeafyGrass lips) enclosing the arena, notched behind the gate; retinted terrain materials + baseplate to the palette

Lighting: ClockTime 16.4 golden hour, warm ColorShift_Top vs cool violet Ambient/OutdoorAmbient, Atmosphere (Density .38, dusty warm Color), ordered post stack (ColorCorrection warm grade, threshold-1.6 Bloom, subtle SunRays)
capture_angles verify: first pass showed default-white tiers clashing - retinted tiers/caps sandstone + walls terracotta, re-captured clean

recipe.text: Recipe: paint_texture two kit templates FIRST, then clone-per-segment with per-instance tint/height variation for a ruin ring. Chord width = 2*r*tan(pi/N) keeps 24 segments seamless at any radius. Terrain FillBall hill ring with a notch aligned to the gate implies a world beyond and a route in. Golden-hour warm/cool split + dusty Atmosphere unifies sand/terracotta instantly. Braziers = Neon coal + Fire + PointLight (shadows on only 2 of 4 for perf; CastShadow off on all dressing). Prior-rung artifacts (SiegeArena parts, BastionSiege pads, rigs, dummy) moved off-scene, not destroyed.
